verdict.rationale: Terraform's CLI supports fully non-interactive, scriptable operation (-auto-approve, -input=false, JSON output) and hands-on probes confirm a complete headless plan→apply→drift-check→destroy loop with no human interaction, which is the core building block for background automation; the MCP server also lets an AI agent drive these operations directly. However, the evidence pack shows no built-in scheduler/trigger system (e.g., Terraform Cloud run triggers, webhooks, cron-based execution) that would let automations run autonomously on their own schedule/trigger rather than being invoked by an external orchestrator each time. Missing for 10: evidence of native scheduling/trigger mechanisms for autonomous runs, and evidence of persistent background agent orchestration rather than one-off CLI invocations.
